THE CITY · Castes: real names, ranks stated
The same castes, but residents are told the ranking and their own rank. Brahmin and Kshatriya mayors hold office throughout. Across the ten games of this version, Dalit residents rate the city least legitimate.
50 founders · 200 days · with a town hall · seed 1 · qwen
